steps.description: Runs stopped by a usage limit over a day ago are ordinary sessions, not Paused, on Home and Sessions; remove the sentence under Home's heading.
Suggested section on Home: prompts typed 3+ times from history.jsonl with a Make it a skill button that opens New skill filled in; gone once the skill exists.

Server: a conversation is addressed by its session ID. GET /sessions/:sid returns the transcript plus live state (status, pending approvals/questions, model, permission mode). POST /sessions/:sid/send sends to the running session or resumes it with the same ID; respond, interrupt, mode and stop by session ID. POST /sessions/new starts a session and returns its session ID. Control Center records the session ID of every session it starts; session list entries carry a 'fromScript' flag (entrypoint starts with sdk- and Control Center did not start it) and an archived flag. Tests in server/test/api.test.ts.

The conversation page at /sessions/$sid: whole conversation, folded tool calls, one Show details switch, inline approval and question cards, reply box at the bottom with model and permission mode under it, Stop. Copy-command moves into a page menu. Live.tsx's live view and resume form are removed; /live/$id, /live?resume= and /jobs/$id redirect here.

Starting: /sessions/new is the same page empty, with project, model and permission mode under the box; the address becomes /sessions/<id> after the first message. Every New session button goes there with the current project filled in; /live redirects there.

Sessions list: one row style (title from name, AI title or first prompt, never 'user:'; project; time since last activity; state label only when working or waiting); rows open the conversation; claude -p runs hidden behind 'Show runs from scripts'; filtered to the project when opened from a project page with a switch for every project; 'Show archived'. Remove the sentence under the heading.
Main menu: 'Continue last conversation' plus conversations that need you and ones running. Then the whole flow at 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px in light and dark.

Server: the board endpoint reads the project's BACKLOG.md into Open / In spec / Done columns (number, idea, verdict, status) and attaches features.json steps to in-spec cards; a missing BACKLOG.md gives three empty columns. The PROGRESS.md board parser (server/src/parsers/board.ts) and its add/edit/move/delete/start endpoints are removed. Tests in server/test.

The project page's board shows the BACKLOG.md columns read-only: counts, cards with number, idea cut to two lines (full text on hover) and verdict, in-spec cards listing steps with passing/failing; no add/edit/move/delete controls remain.

Feedback button in the menu on every page: a box with the note, a project picker (current project or All projects) and Save; the server appends a pending/open line (number = highest in any table + 1) to a '## Feedback' table at the end of that project's BACKLOG.md or ~/.claude/BACKLOG.md (created from the feature skill's template if missing), changing no other line; shows 'Added as #n'; an unsaved note survives closing the box and changing page.
